entries.title: A crewmate sees the picture you sent with your message
entries.body: When your project runs on Automatic, the crewmate that takes your message now gets the pictures and files you attached, as it already did elsewhere. When a picture cannot be opened, the crewmate says so and asks for it instead of answering without seeing it.
entries.noPicture: The change is what a crewmate receives with its first message, which no view of the app shows.
